experiments.study_type: BLM-mediated pulmonary fibrosis model in mice treated with MSC-exos
experiments.procedure_text: Mice given intratracheal BLM to induce pulmonary fibrosis, treated with MSC-exos via tail vein; lung tissue analyzed after 21 days.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: A pulmonary fibrosis model was established based on previous reports
experiments.animal_counts_evidence: control group, BLM group, and BLM + MSC-exos group(n = 3)
experiments.route_evidence: BLM...was intratracheally injected...treated with 20 μg MSC-exos...via tail vein injection

endpoints.label: Pulmonary fibrosis pathology (HE/Masson staining)
endpoints.evidence: subjected to both HE and Masson staining

endpoints.label: EMT markers (MMP2, MMP9, N-cadherin, snail, vimentin, fibronectin, E-cadherin)
endpoints.evidence: MSC-exos inhibit EMT process in BLM-induced PF model

endpoints.label: Inflammation via NOD1/NF-κB/NLRP3 pathway (IL-1beta, IL-18)
endpoints.evidence: suppress inflammation in the BLM-induced PF model by regulating the NOD1/NF-κB/NLRP3 pathway

endpoints.label: Fibrosis markers α-SMA and Co1-I
endpoints.evidence: RT-qPCR detection of α-SMA and Co1-I expression in mouse lung tissue

substances.name: BLM
substances.evidence: 3 mg/kg of BLM (Zhejiang Hisun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., China) was intratracheally injected

substances.name: MSC-exos
substances.evidence: treated with 20 μg MSC-exos in 100 μL PBS via tail vein injection

substances.name: sterile saline
substances.evidence: control group mice were intratracheally injected with an equal amount of sterile saline

substances.name: 1 % pentobarbital sodium
substances.evidence: anesthetized with 1 % pentobarbital sodium via intraperitoneal injection

exposure.conditions: MSC-exos in 100 μL PBS via tail vein injection

experiments.exposure_evidence: 3 mg/kg of BLM...was intratracheally injected...euthanized after a duration of 21 days
experiments.notes: Approved by Experimental Animal Ethics Review Committee (SYT2023036). BLM dose in mg/kg, MSC-exos dose in μg.

experiments.study_type: In vitro BLM injury model in A549 cells treated with MSC-exos
experiments.procedure_text: A549 cells stimulated with BLM to establish injury model, then treated with exosomes; proliferation, EMT and inflammation markers detected.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: To establish an in vitro injury model,1* 10 5 A549 cells were inoculated
experiments.route_evidence: stimulated with 50 μM BLM for 24 h...after exosome (2 μg/mL) treatment

endpoints.label: Cell proliferation (CCK-8)
endpoints.evidence: In order to evaluate the proliferation of A549 cells

endpoints.label: EMT markers (MMP2, MMP9, N-cadherin, snail, vimentin, fibronectin, E-cadherin)

endpoints.label: Fibrosis markers α-SMA and Co1-I
endpoints.evidence: RT-qPCR detection of α-SMA and Co1-I expression in A549 cells

endpoints.label: NLRP3 overexpression reversal effect
